reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the playbook's preferred position for NOSOLICIT is that no non-solicit bind the Customer; the absence of any solicitation, no-hire or inducement covenant in this transfer and servicing agreement therefore meets the preferred position.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — the cited Article IX paragraphs are unmodified in the rendered redline.
The failed deterministic checks (duration and general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure and do not undermine the conclusion.

Rationale is consistent with the cited text: the referenced 'employee' mentions are limited-recourse and ERISA/Benefit Plan references, which impose no hiring or solicitation restriction, so classifying as compliant rather than 'missing' is appropriate for a rule whose preferred outcome is clause absence.
